All 5 containers running. WebUI is now healthy (the earlier unhealthy was during startup). Let me verify the frontend actually renders the TruSpace app and API works more thoroughly. Let me try registering a user or logging in? The seed admin? Let's check the frontend page content, and test the Open WebUI port.

Let me verify port 3333 and IPFS cluster health. Also check backend is functional by hitting a public endpoint.

The installation appears successful. Let me do a final comprehensive verification.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== Ports ==="; for p in 3000 8000 5001 8080 3333 9094; do printf "port %s: " $p; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 5 http://localhost:$p/ ; done; echo "=== IPFS id ==="; curl -s -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id | head -c 150; echo; echo "=== cluster health ==="; curl -s http://localhost:9094/health; echo; echo "=== frontend contains TruSpace app? ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000 | grep -oE "TruSpace|_next" | sort -u | head; echo "=== webui status ==="; docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' workspace-webui-1
